import.title: Business Starters
import.hint: Install a Business Starter from the catalog. A starter adds a domain to this organization's own application, next to the others you have installed; one of the old kind replaces every definition of the organization and can only be installed while it holds no data. Preview first: the preview runs the whole install and writes nothing.
